title: 日本传染病监测决策简报 | 2025-05-30 至 2026-05-30
summary: 本期共纳入 86 个疾病信号，记录病例 4,178,290 例，最新一期病例 27,006 例。当前最需要关注的是 甲型肝炎。当前来源未提供死亡数字段，因此不能把空值或全空记录解释为死亡负担不存在。

issues: Death count field is not provided by this source; legacy zero values should be treated as unavailable.
Some incidence rates are WPP-computed crude population rates, not source-provided rates.
Sentinel surveillance data are present; crude population incidence should be interpreted as contextual, not as a sentinel per-site rate.
